discription: A pulse wave synth with an ADSR envelope and a resonant low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = LFPulse.ar(freq, 0, pulseWidth);    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
